rows.episode_title: Begins
rows.synopsis: Jill decides to start her own farm in the family barn. But she discovers it's already occupied—by a bossy duckling.
rows.situation: Jill's animals have to move out of her bedroom before the new baby arrives, so she starts her own farm in the yard even though she wants everything to stay the same.
rows.notes: Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog: animals out of Jill's room, Quackety the bossy duckling in the barn, Jamma talk). Jill names the change she dreads and works it out with Jamma. No controlled topic fits a farm-start story; left empty by design. Content note: new-baby arrival setup.

rows.episode_title: Sisters
rows.synopsis: Jill and Jacky's new baby brother arrives. The sisters can't cuddle him yet, so Jacky looks after a precious egg while Jill tends to Barbara the sheep.
rows.situation: A new baby brother comes home and both sisters want to be first to hold him, so Jacky learns to wait by caring for the golden egg the way Mum cares for the baby.
rows.notes: Script tier (Gestdown SRT, content verified against catalog: big sisters, first huggle, Jacky egg-sitting like Mum with the baby). Mummy coaches patience explicitly. No controlled topic fits.

rows.episode_title: Babies
rows.synopsis: Jacky wants to name her new baby brother, but none of her suggestions work for the family, so she needs big sister Jill's help.
rows.situation: Jacky tries and fails to pick the new baby's name on her own, feels no one will listen, then the sisters build the name Joshy together.
rows.notes: Script tier (Gestdown SRT, content verified against catalog: Squashy, Sleepy and Softy rejected, Jamma listens, sisters choose Joshy together). Jamma's line anchors the repair: two big sisters make magic when they work together.

rows.episode_title: Egg
rows.synopsis: The golden egg's gone missing, so Jill, Al, and Pickle search for it. But even with Tucker Pup's sniffing skills, they're always one step behind.
rows.situation: The precious golden egg rolls away and Al and Pickle are heartbroken, so Jill leads a farmwide search, thinks like an egg, and finds it with the goats.
rows.notes: Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog: lost golden egg, Barbara's baa clue, goats Biff and Bop find it). Quackety shares the worry beat. No controlled topic fits an egg-hunt story.

rows.episode_title: Rainy Day
rows.synopsis: As heavy rain pours down, Jill has to rescue her lost sheep and stop her goats from creating a ruckus around the farm.
rows.situation: In a storm, Jill tries to rescue her lost sheep and herd her goats single-handedly, refuses offers of help, gets stuck, then takes Jamma's hand and succeeds as a team.
rows.notes: Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog: storm, lost Barbara and Little Lamb, stuck boots and bike, Jamma's help accepted). The explicit lesson is that help is not failure. No controlled topic fits a farm rescue.

rows.episode_title: Photo
rows.synopsis: Jill wants her animals in the new family photo. But getting them to look at the camera—and making sure Jacky stays clean—is hard.
rows.situation: Pickle feels he has to look special to belong in the farm family photo, and Jill fixes problems for everyone until the family shows her she belongs front and center too.
rows.notes: Script tier (Gestdown SRT, content verified against catalog: farm family photo, Pickle's straw bow, chicken dust baths, Jill brought to the front). Pickle voices feeling left out of the photo and Jill responds. Secondary beat noted, not tagged: the sheep leave to explore and Jamma moves in.

rows.episode_title: Hiccups
rows.synopsis: Jill accidentally drops the golden egg, and it starts to hiccup. When she can't help it stop, Jill wonders if she can be a good farmer.
rows.situation: After Jill drops the golden egg and every cure fails, she decides she is not a good farmer and gives up, until Quackety reminds her who she is and two heartbeats end the hiccups.
rows.notes: Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog: dropped egg, hiccup cures, 'just Jill', two heartbeats, double song). Age-band edge call: pushed to 5-7 because the beat is a repeated-failure and self-worth crisis, heavier than the series' usual preschool reassurance.

rows.episode_title: Family
rows.synopsis: Jamma's moving onto the farm and Jill and Jacky want to help—but the golden egg has decided it's hatching day.
rows.situation: Sibling teamwork on a two-job family day: the golden egg is hatching while Jamma's trailer arrives, and Jill is torn between them.
rows.notes: Script tier, upgraded from synopsis-fallback in the transcript top-up pass (2026-11-14): Forever Dreaming transcript (topic 236348, '02x01 - Family', posted 2026-03-09) fetched and identity-checked against the catalog synopsis (Jamma's trailer arriving, the golden egg hatching, the baby dragons); content matches. The script fixed who learns what (Jill learns she cannot be in two places and that trusting Jacky is her job as big sister; Jacky learns he can finish a big job alone by remembering how Jamma wants to feel), the shown coping (they ask for help and trade trust: 'I know you can do this'), and the emotional beat (Jill's guilt when Jamma's trailer does not feel like home yet: "I think I made Jamma sad"). Gestdown lookup for S2E1 returned an empty manifest the same session. Topics: Monsters & magic covers the dragon hatch; no controlled topic fits the trailer move.

rows.episode_title: Darling
rows.synopsis: Jill's excited about the arrival of Darling, a senior donkey. When she tries to help settle him in, Darling seems like he'd rather not be there.
rows.situation: Jill's usual baby-animal care does not work for Darling, an elderly donkey who will not settle, so she learns new arrivals may need a different kind of care.
rows.notes: Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog: Darling arrives, welcome song, quiet stall, Jill's care misses). Jamma names the lesson: give him kind patience.

rows.episode_title: Dragon Babies
rows.synopsis: Al and Pickle need a break, so Jill babysits the dragons for them. But she quickly discovers it's more work than she thought.
rows.situation: Jill babysits the dragon babies, waves off Al's advice, and watches her tidy routine fall apart until she works out that these babies want everything done playfully.
rows.notes: Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog: Huffity and Puffity, exercise-feed-change routine, tractor feeding games). She admits she should have taken Al's advice. Topic anchored to the babysitted dragons.

rows.episode_title: Bedtime
rows.synopsis: Jill is sick in bed, so Jacky takes over barn bedtime duties and finds out the animals would much rather keep playing.
rows.situation: With Jill sick in bed, Jacky promises to run barn bedtime alone, then finds the animals would rather play games, and has to admit she cannot do it without help.
rows.notes: Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog: Jill's sore throat, important voice, hide-and-seek, Daddy steps in, family bedtime ritual works). Content note: mild illness theme.

rows.episode_title: Barn
rows.synopsis: Darling the donkey gets locked inside the barn with the dragon babies and needs to keep them happy until Jill can get them out.
rows.situation: The wind latches the barn door with Darling locked in guarding the dragon babies, and everyone keeps trying ways in, from a duck who has forgotten how to fly to digging under the wall.
rows.notes: Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog: windy latch, hee-haw game inside, Quackety's failed flight, Tucker's dig). Quackety's sadness about not flying is a secondary beat, noted not tagged.

rows.episode_title: Tucker
rows.synopsis: Jacky volunteers to care for Tucker the pup, who has an injured paw, while a stressed Jill takes a calming stroll with Darling.
rows.situation: Jacky volunteers to nurse Tucker through a sore paw, tries every toy and song to bring back his woof, and discovers what he wants is quiet time with her.
rows.notes: Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog: vet bandage, tea party, puppy song, xylophone, quiet woof). Parallel Jill thread: Darling teaches that slowing down gets things done; calming strategies shown throughout. Content note: injured paw, no distress shown.

rows.episode_title: Party
rows.synopsis: It's Harvest Day, which means games, music, and lots of freshly picked sister sweetcorn for the family—and the community—to enjoy.
rows.situation: The sisters plan a whole Harvest Day party in one day, and when the truck breaks down, Quackety the duckling has to find the courage to fly and invite the neighbors.
rows.notes: Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog via page 351088: Harvest Day, flat tire, run-and-flap takeoff, farm song, sharing stall). Topics anchored to the party itself and the song the family writes and performs; party games are mentioned but minor.
